title: Text Line Justification
statement:
Given an array of non-empty `words` and an integer `maxWidth`, pack as many words as possible onto each line in order and format every line to have **exact** length `maxWidth`.

Formatting rules
- **Greedy packing:** Pack consecutive words into a line as long as the sum of their lengths plus at least one space between adjacent words does not exceed `maxWidth`.
- **Full justification (non-last lines with 2+ words):** Distribute the total padding spaces (`maxWidth - sumOfWordLengths`) as evenly as possible across the `gaps = wordCount - 1` gaps between words. If the spaces do not divide evenly, the leftmost `extra = spaces % gaps` gaps each receive one additional space.
- **Left justification (the last line, or any line containing only 1 word):** Separate words by a single space and pad the right end with spaces until the line length equals `maxWidth`.

Contract
- `words` has at least one word, and every word satisfies `1 <= word.length() <= maxWidth`.
- Every returned string must have length equal to `maxWidth`.

Examples
- `["Ship", "clean", "code", "to", "teams", "every", "day."]`, `maxWidth = 14` ->
  `"Ship     clean"`, `"code  to teams"`, `"every day.    "`.
- `["Fast", "builds", "require", "instrumentation", "and", "tests"]`, `maxWidth = 16` ->
  `"Fast      builds"`, `"require         "`, `"instrumentation "`, `"and tests       "`.
- `["Code", "well"]`, `maxWidth = 10` -> `["Code well "]`.

examples.input: 14; Ship clean code to teams every day.
16; Fast builds require instrumentation and tests

hints: Use an outer index i pointing to the first word of the next line. Advance j greedily while the words [i..j] fit within maxWidth with single spaces: lineWordChars + words[j].length() + (j - i) <= maxWidth.
Count wordsOnLine = j - i and totalSpaces = maxWidth - lineWordChars. Determine whether this line is left-justified: that happens if and only if j == words.length (last line) or wordsOnLine == 1.

For a left-justified line, join words with single spaces and append trailing spaces to reach maxWidth. For a fully justified line with gaps = wordsOnLine - 1, put base = totalSpaces / gaps spaces in every gap, plus 1 extra space in the first (totalSpaces % gaps) gaps. Intended complexity: O(totalChars) (O(n) in total output characters), O(maxWidth) working space (O(n) including output).
inputSyntax: Input: maxWidth; space-separated words, for example: 14; Ship clean code to teams every day.
sampleInput: 14; Ship clean code to teams every day.
